typography.evidence:
Hero set as two Archivo lines at 44px with tight leading, IBM Plex lead at 18px / 1.65, body 16px. Audit: Archivo + IBM Plex Sans; desktop sizes 12.5, 14, 14.4, 16, 18, 20, 24, 38.4, 44 (nine, not 5–7); body 16px; long_line_count 0. Mobile h1 stacks as three lines because of forced
.
strengths: Archivo for wordmark/h1–h3/phones and IBM Plex Sans for body/UI is a two-role industrial pairing.
Hero is deliberately two lines with heading leading ~1.1, 16px body, 0 long lines.
Display vs body load is clear in the audit and holds across inner pageheads.

issues.problem: Nine computed sizes on desktop against a 5–7 step scale. 14px, 14.4px and 20px are stray.
issues.fix: Map every rule to the six DESIGN steps only. Delete 14px, 14.4px, and 20px declarations.
